issue.description:
## 🔧 Tech Story
As a developer,
I want to define and write the test plan and test cases,

logs.description: Reflection on the test cases for the backend.

Defined and implemented auth-related unit and API tests (login, register, getMe, middleware). Set up the test infrastructure including repository and service mocks, and a reusable test app factory; fixed some issues with the npm commands, and lintage/prettier formating.
